subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from agent-driven `config.patch` writes?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and may affect a model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so automation cannot choose the product/security contract safely.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

options.title: Only reduce scary progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu streaming boolean-only and rely on the shared `exit N` wording, which is smaller but still leaves no way to keep streaming while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Add `channels.feishu.streaming` to the model-facing config mutation allowlist, which helps recovery but broadens operator-controlled config writes and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

likelyOwner.reason: The current blame and recent merged PR history tie this handle to the inspected Feishu and shared progress/error paths most directly affected by the decision.
